scope: All 58 mapped Richebourg parcels and all 10 recorded holder identifiers reviewed for Tier 2 (#425) through the shared holder table; 36 filings / 1,454 pages screened, plus 39 filings / 504 pages of eight related companies that hold no current Richebourg rights.
